To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Rht8 gene can be successfully used in Indian spring wheat cultivators for reducing plant height and can be used in combination with Rht1 to reduce plant height further.
Rht8 gene is a potential source of height reduction in elite Indian wheat cultivars.
Rht8 is a dwarfing gene that reduces plant height and coleoptile length without affecting seedling shoot length.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the exploitation of Rht8 gene as another source of dwarfism for Indian wheat breeding program.
the development and evaluation of F3:4 wheat lines with reduced height due to Rht8 gene and Rht1 gene in Indian spring wheat background.
identification of Rht8 gene in elite Indian wheat cultivars and evaluation of the effects of Rht8 on wheat height and other agronomic traits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Rht1 is the best source of dwarfism for Indian spring wheat cultivators.
Rht1 gene is the most effective gene for reduction in coleoptiles and seedling shoot height whereas Rht8 gene is effective for reduction in plant height and biomass.
Rht8 is a dwarfing gene with less impact on coleoptile length, seedling shoot length and plant biomass.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Rht8 gene has a potential of being used in Indian spring wheat breeding programme as it does not affect the seedling vigor and can be exploited for reducing the plant height without compromising the seedling vigor.
Rht8 gene could be used as an alternate dwarf gene for wheat breeding in India.
Rht8 gene is an alternate dwarfing source in Indian elite spring wheat cultivars and can be exploited in future breeding program.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Rht8 can be used for reducing plant height in Indian spring wheat cultivators.
, Rht8 gene can be utilized as an alternate dwarf gene in Indian spring wheat.
Rht8 is another alternate dwarfing gene which can be used to optimize plant height in elite Indian spring wheats.
